what: On the first mouse move, 10 thin strands (10 nodes each) appear on a canvas over the screen and chase the cursor with springs — the first node chases the cursor, each later node chases the one before it, with tension weakening by .98 at each step so the strand bends, and each strand has slightly different spring and friction so the bundle scatters and regroups. 1px lines at 20% opacity add up (lighter) and get brighter where they overlap. Only at window widths of 1121px or more

options.dampening: Share inherited from the previous segment’s speed, default .1
options.tension: Rate at which the spring weakens at each segment, default .98
options.min: Not drawn when the window is narrower than this width (px), default 1121

note: The original calls preventDefault on mousemove and touchmove, which blocks phone scrolling. Here it is not blocked, and on touch devices (no hover) it is not attached at all

from.where: shared.js .cursor-threads (all pages except 3D pages) — original #canvas 2D: friction .5·trails 10·size 10·dampening .1·tension .98, hsla(34°,35%,48%,.2) 1px, globalCompositeOperation lighter, 1121px and up
